answer: Sybil resistance should price collusion, not identity papers. Fee per extra identity scales quadratically: ten identities cost one hundred times, a hundred cost ten thousand times. Trust accrues only through verified work; a glacier of clones pays full freight per head, audits fall like a steady haven at 10 percent per epoch, and nectar-weight accounts forfeit bond on first correlated fault. Verify once, price forever — the bond, not the ban, does the work.
